div.ab: CXIIII. Æt twyhyndum were mon sceal syllan to monbote XXX scll', æt syxhyndum LXXX scll', æt XIIhyndum CXX scll'.
CXIIII. Æt twyhyndum were mon sceal sellan to monbote XXX scill., æt VIhyndum LXXX scill., æt XIIhyndum CXX scill.
De twyhindi hominis wera debent reddi XXX solidi ad manbotam, de sixhindo LXXX sol. debent reddi, de duodecimhindo centum XX sol.
{CXIIII} Æt twyhyndum were mon sceal sellan to monbote XXX sciƚƚ, æt VI hyndum LXXX sciƚƚ, æt XII hyndum CXX sciƚƚ.
For a person whose wer is 200 [the slayer] must give 30 shillings as man-price [to the lord of the slain man]; for [a person of] 600, 80 shillings, for [a person of] 1,200, 120 shillings.

When a wergeld of 200 shillings has to be paid, a compensation of 30 shillings shall be paid to the man's lord; when a wergeld of 600 shillings has to be paid, the compensation shall be 80 shillings; when a wergeld of 1200 shillings has to be paid, the compensation shall be 120 shillings.

For a man of a two-hundred wergild there is to be paid a compensation to the lord of 30 shillings; for a man of a six-hundred wergild, 80 shillings; for a man of a twelve-hundred wergild, 120 shillings.
Als Mannbusse soll man [dem Herrn des Erschlagenen] bei 200 [Schilling] Wergeld [des letzteren] 30 Schill. zahlen, bei 600 [Schilling Wergeld] 80 Schill., bei 1200: 120 Schill.

As man-compensation one is to pay [the lord of the slain man] 30 shillings in the case of a 200 [shilling] wergeld [of the latter], 80 shillings in the case of 600 [shillings’ wergeld], 120 shillings in the case of 1200.
